summary: A complete, runnable Next.js App Router blog template scaffolded by create-barkpark-app, demonstrating how to build a content-driven site on Barkpark's API with server-side fetching, pagination, draft preview, and seed data.

intentions.title: Prove the SDK end-to-end in a realistic app
intentions.evidence: lib/barkpark.ts uses @barkpark/core + @barkpark/nextjs/server to fetch typed documents via the REST API; app/page.tsx calls getDocs with pagination; this exercises the full stack from schema to render

intentions.title: Reduce time-to-first-blog to near zero via scaffolding + seed
intentions.evidence: seeds/seed.ts inserts 2 authors, 3 tags, 7 posts (6 published, 1 draft) via the mutate API; package.json.tmpl exposes a 'pnpm seed' command; barkpark.config.ts.tmpl wires env vars automatically

intentions.title: Demonstrate workspace/project URL scoping
intentions.evidence: lib/barkpark.ts computes SCOPE via scopePrefix(); seeds/seed.ts builds SCOPE from BARKPARK_WORKSPACE + BARKPARK_PROJECT env vars, showing /w/<ws>/p/<project> vs flat /v1 routing

intentions.title: Model the draft/published perspective pattern
intentions.evidence: lib/barkpark.ts passes perspective=drafts + Authorization header + revalidate:0 for draft fetches; seed.ts deliberately leaves post-upcoming unpublished to create a draft preview demo scenario; queries.ts documents the GROQ-ready postBySlug filter

intentions.title: Establish Next.js cache-tag discipline as the reference pattern
intentions.evidence: fetchJson in lib/barkpark.ts sets next:{tags,revalidate:60} using bp:ds:<dataset>:type:<type> and bp:ds:<dataset>:doc:<id> tag shapes, aligning with the @barkpark/nextjs revalidate webhook contract

intentions.title: Show content schema definition as code (schema-as-config)
intentions.evidence: schemas/post.ts, author.ts, tag.ts define documents with richText, slug, reference, array-of-reference fields as plain TS objects — the same shape the codegen pipeline consumes

intentions.title: Prepare for typed-query migration (ADR-003 forward-compat)
intentions.evidence: lib/queries.ts exports GROQ strings annotated as 'ready for the codegen + typed-query migration (ADR-003, Phase 8)' — informational today, wired tomorrow without file-level changes
